projectionInvariant: ACTIVE=true; STALE/REVOKED/NONE=false; unresolved authority is not coerced to false and blocks scoring/adoption.

cases.name: human-validation-creates-active
cases.assertion: Only human transition to ACTIVE.

cases.name: ordinary-patch-remains-active
cases.assertion: No material trigger; stays within declared version scope.

cases.name: ordinary-minor-remains-active
cases.assertion: No material trigger; stays within declared compatibility scope.

cases.name: major-version-review
cases.assertion: Review required; candidate maps REVIEW_REQUIRED to non-active STALE pending human review.

cases.name: major-capability-invalidates
cases.assertion: Affected scope is no longer current.

cases.name: security-regression-invalidates
cases.assertion: Security regression affects validated use.

cases.name: active-exploitation-invalidates
cases.assertion: Credible exploitation affects evaluated use.

cases.name: license-change-invalidates-scope
cases.assertion: Scope no longer establishes approval; human may revoke after confirmation.

cases.name: pricing-alone-no-invalidation
cases.assertion: Default technical validation unaffected.

cases.name: price-sensitive-approval-review
cases.assertion: Only explicit price-bound approval scope requires review.

cases.name: api-availability-review
cases.assertion: Material use/access change requires human review.

cases.name: repeated-observation-no-change
cases.assertion: Observation repetition is not validation evidence or invalidation.

cases.name: radar-publication-no-activation
cases.assertion: Publication cannot create ACTIVE.

cases.name: registry-observation-only
cases.assertion: Registry observation alone cannot change validation or registry semantics.

cases.name: registry-event-one-way-invalidation
cases.assertion: Fact may invalidate validation; no reverse registry write edge.

cases.name: revoked-false
cases.assertion: REVOKED projection false.

cases.name: stale-false
cases.assertion: STALE projection false.

cases.name: human-revalidation-after-invalidation
cases.assertion: New human record supersedes old record; automation did not activate it.

cases.name: ownership-change-review
cases.assertion: Human review required where trust/support assumption applies.

cases.name: time-alone-no-invalidation
cases.assertion: No implicit expiry.

cases.name: popularity-change-no-invalidation
cases.assertion: Popularity cannot mutate validation.

cases.name: source-reporting-change-no-invalidation
cases.assertion: Metadata change alone not material.

cases.name: conflicting-authority-fails-closed
cases.assertion: No boolean projection while authority conflicts; fail closed.
